components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The default quiet action: outlined, compact, and flat.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #dfdcd4); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--c-ink-soft, #4a4852); font: 400 14px/20px var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-ink, #16151a) 25%, transparent); color: var(--c-ink, #16151a); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-g2, #3f72bd); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: A rare solid action used when the interface truly starts or controls an operation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-width: 96px; height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--c-ink, #16151a); color: var(--c-paper, #fbfaf7); font: 400 14px/20px var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-g2, #3f72bd); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A compact recessed field that stays subordinate to the filter labels around it.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-search" type="search" placeholder="Character / reading / U+9AA8" aria-label="Search" />
components.css: .ds-input-search { box-sizing: border-box; width: 208px; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #dfdcd4); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--c-paper-sunk, #f2f0ea); color: var(--c-ink, #16151a); font: 400 14px/20px var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: var(--c-ink-mute, #86838d); } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-g2, #3f72bd); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip — Selected
components.description: The high-clarity selected state used across dense filter groups.
components.css: .ds-chip-selected { height: 28px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--c-ink, #16151a); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--c-ink, #16151a); color: var(--c-paper, #fbfaf7); font: 400 12px/16px var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-chip-selected span { opacity: 0.7; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chip-selected:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-chip-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-g2, #3f72bd); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip — Resting
components.description: The outlined resting state; hover strengthens the rule without adding elevation.
components.css: .ds-chip-resting { height: 28px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #dfdcd4); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--c-paper, #fbfaf7); color: var(--c-ink-soft, #4a4852); font: 400 12px/16px var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-chip-resting span { color: var(--c-ink-mute, #86838d); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chip-resting:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-ink, #16151a) 30%, transparent); color: var(--c-ink, #16151a); } .ds-chip-resting:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-g2, #3f72bd); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Choice
components.description: A recessed well whose selected option returns to Paper with the system's smallest lift.
components.css: .ds-segmented { height: 28px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 1px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #dfdcd4); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--c-paper-sunk, #f2f0ea); } .ds-segmented button { height: 22px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--c-ink-mute, #86838d); font: 400 12px/16px var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: color 150ms, background 150ms; } .ds-segmented button:hover { color: var(--c-ink-soft, #4a4852); } .ds-segmented .ds-segmented-active { background: var(--c-paper, #fbfaf7); color: var(--c-ink, #16151a); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06); } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-g2, #3f72bd); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Region Options
components.description: An artwork-safe regional selector whose edge and Paper surface carry selection independently of its label.
components.css: .ds-region-choice { height: 28px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--c-paper-sunk, #f2f0ea); } .ds-region-option { min-width: 22px; height: 22px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #dfdcd4); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--c-paper-sunk, #f2f0ea); color: var(--c-ink-mute, #86838d); font: 400 11px/1 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-region-option-active { border-color: var(--c-ink-soft, #4a4852); background: var(--c-paper, #fbfaf7); color: var(--c-ink, #16151a); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-region-option-resting:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-ink-mute, #86838d) 45%, var(--c-rule, #dfdcd4)); color: var(--c-ink-soft, #4a4852); } .ds-region-option-active:hover { border-color: var(--c-ink, #16151a); } } .ds-region-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-g2, #3f72bd); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-region-option { transition: none; } }

components.name: Floating Menu
components.description: The sole floating surface: a compact Paper menu with a quiet, temporary shadow.
components.css: .ds-menu { box-sizing: border-box; width: 176px; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #dfdcd4); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--c-paper, #fbfaf7); color: var(--c-ink, #16151a); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-menu button { width: 100%; min-height: 36px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--c-ink-soft, #4a4852); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; text-align: left; transition: color 150ms, background 150ms; } .ds-menu button:hover { background: var(--c-paper-sunk, #f2f0ea); color: var(--c-ink, #16151a); } .ds-menu span { color: var(--c-g2, #3f72bd); } .ds-menu button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-g2, #3f72bd); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Character Comparison Row
components.description: The core evidence row: overprint thumbnail, equal regional tracks, and tabular metadata.
components.html: 國国国U+56FD国U+56FD國U+570B國U+570B8
components.css: .ds-character-row { min-width: 720px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0, 1fr) 72px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #dfdcd4); background: var(--c-paper, #fbfaf7); color: var(--c-ink, #16151a); text-decoration: none; transition: background 100ms; } .ds-character-row:hover { background: var(--c-paper-sunk, #f2f0ea); } .ds-row-overprint { position: relative; width: 60px; height: 60px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 52px; line-height: 1; isolation: isolate; } .ds-row-overprint b, .ds-row-overprint i { position: absolute; grid-area: 1 / 1; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; mix-blend-mode: var(--overprint-blend, darken); } .ds-row-overprint b { color: var(--c-ink, #16151a); font-family: 'Hanji Sans TW', sans-serif; } .ds-row-overprint i { color: var(--c-g1, #d1503f); font-family: 'Hanji Sans CN', sans-serif; opacity: 0.78; } .ds-row-cells { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .ds-row-cells > span { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; font-size: 44px; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-row-cells small, .ds-row-meta { color: var(--c-ink-mute, #86838d); font: 400 10px/14px var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-cn { font-family: 'Hanji Sans CN', sans-serif; } .ds-jp { font-family: 'Hanji Sans JP', sans-serif; } .ds-hk { font-family: 'Hanji Sans HK', sans-serif; } .ds-tw { font-family: 'Hanji Sans TW', sans-serif; } .ds-row-meta { text-align: right; font-size: 12px; color: var(--c-ink-soft, #4a4852); } .ds-character-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-g2, #3f72bd); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Overprint Glyph
components.description: Hanji's signature comparison object: one ink baseline with proof-colored regional departures.
components.html: 返返返返
components.css: .ds-overprint { width: 176px; height: 176px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; position: relative; isolation: isolate; font-size: 176px; line-height: 1; } .ds-overprint span { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--layer-color); mix-blend-mode: var(--overprint-blend, darken); opacity: 0.78; transition: translate 420ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.4, 0.36, 1), opacity 220ms ease; } .ds-overprint span:first-child { opacity: 1; } .ds-overprint:hover span:nth-child(1) { translate: -3.9px -1.6px; } .ds-overprint:hover span:nth-child(2) { translate: -1.3px -0.5px; } .ds-overprint:hover span:nth-child(3) { translate: 1.3px 0.5px; } .ds-overprint:hover span:nth-child(4) { translate: 3.9px 1.6px; } .ds-overprint-cn { --layer-color: var(--c-ink, #16151a); font-family: 'Hanji Sans CN', sans-serif; } .ds-overprint-jp { --layer-color: var(--c-g1, #d1503f); font-family: 'Hanji Sans JP', sans-serif; } .ds-overprint-hk { --layer-color: var(--c-g2, #3f72bd); font-family: 'Hanji Sans HK', sans-serif; } .ds-overprint-tw { --layer-color: var(--c-g3, #b8871f); font-family: 'Hanji Sans TW', sans-serif; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-overprint span { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Hanji behaves like a comparative proof pulled from a careful type workshop: warm paper, cool ink, fine rules, registration colors, and character forms treated as evidence rather than ornament. The overprint is the system's signature object. It places regional forms in one footprint, then lets their departures emerge as colored registration marks.

The system is precise, quiet, scholarly, and materially print-like without becoming nostalgic. It is dense where comparison benefits from density and generous where a character needs to be inspected. Controls feel like restrained editorial instruments: compact, clear, lightly outlined, and solid only when selection needs to read immediately.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and cool ink in light mode, with an equally deliberate night proof in dark mode.
Hairline rules and spacing carry structure before color or elevation does.
Regional glyphs are the visual subject; interface furniture stays quiet.
Registration accents describe glyph groups and departures, never geography.
Motion explains stacking, separation, selection, or navigation and yields to reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The Grouping, Not Geography Rule
rules.body: Accents encode glyph grouping and departures; they never assign a permanent color to a region.

rules.name: The Baseline Wins Rule
rules.body: Ink is the reference form; proof colors annotate only where other forms depart, and spacing remains the primary non-color cue.

rules.name: The Region Owns the Glyph Rule
rules.body: Every comparison glyph uses the font for the region it represents, regardless of interface locale.

rules.name: The Interface Follows the Reader Rule
rules.body: Interface copy uses the selected locale's self-hosted CJK face, with sans and serif as equal user-selectable modes.

rules.name: The Figures Line Up Rule
rules.body: Code points, stroke counts, ranks, and page numbers use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Columns Stay Columns Rule
rules.body: Regional character columns do not reflow into cards on narrow screens; scale them or allow horizontal scrolling.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are separated by tone and hairlines; shadows are reserved for a temporary floating layer or a selected inset control.

rules.name: The Quiet Radius Rule
rules.body: Corners soften controls without becoming a visual motif; large capsules belong only to tiny run markers and scroll thumbs.

rules.name: The Selected State Is a Slab Rule
rules.body: Non-regional content filters use ink-on-paper inversion for the selected state, not a brighter border alone. Region options are the explicit artwork-safe exception defined below.

rules.name: The Artwork Never Carries State Rule
rules.body: A region option must remain visibly selected when its flag or text label is removed. State belongs to the control edge and surface, while the artwork only names the region.

rules.name: The Glyph Leads Rule
rules.body: Controls, labels, rules, and motion remain subordinate to the character forms.

dos: Do preserve the current proof-sheet identity when extending or refining the interface.
Do select every data glyph's font from its region, independently of the interface language.
Do use spacing and run separation as the primary comparison cue, with the five proof colors as redundant annotation.
Do keep controls compact, labels explicit, focus visible, and meaningful states understandable without color.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences and keep motion tied to stacking, separation, selection, or navigation.
donts: Don't assign permanent colors to regions or use flags as the primary brand language.
Don't turn the interface into a dashboard of independent cards.
Don't introduce gradients, glass effects, decorative shadows, or effects that compete with the glyphs.
Don't allow the interface locale to substitute for a regional glyph font.
Don't reflow regional comparison columns into a different order on small screens.
